## Introduction

This notebook describes to retrieve the data used for nf-core/createtaxdb benchmarking.

For this benchmarking, we will perform two analyses on real datasets:

- Tracking effects of sequencing depth on classification resource usage on a single database  (10.1016/j.cub.2021.09.031)
- Resource usage of a short and long read datasets on a multiple databases (10.1038/s41564-022-01270-1)

- `curl` (v8.5.0 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu))
- hostile (v2.0.2)

## No R packages used

### Host removal genome

As the samples are human palaeofaeces, and have been handled by human archaeologists and palaeogenomicsts, we will assume the human DNA will be some of the largest 'contaminants' in the sample.

We will use the optimised reference telomere-to-telomere plus HLA sequences offered by the tool [`hostile`](https://github.com/bede/hostile).

```{bash}
export HOSTILE_CACHE_DIR=$(readlink -f reference/)
hostile index fetch --name human-t2t-hla --bowtie2 --minimap2
```

### Ancient DNA dataset 

To test resource usage on different sequencing depths, we will use a sample from [Maixer 2022](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41564-022-01270-1), where an ancient palaeofaeces sequencing library was sequenced multiple times at different depths.

```{bash}
#| eval: false
curl -o sequencing_reads/PRJEB44507.tsv "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/filereport?accession=PRJEB44507&result=read_run&fields=study_accession,sample_accession,secondary_sample_accession,experiment_accession,run_accession,tax_id,scientific_name,instrument_platform,instrument_model,library_name,nominal_length,library_layout,library_strategy,library_source,library_selection,read_count,fastq_bytes,fastq_md5,fastq_ftp,submitted_bytes,submitted_md5,submitted_ftp,submitted_aspera,submitted_format,sra_ftp,sample_alias,sample_title,bam_ftp&format=tsv&download=true&limit=0"
grep -e "/2604" sequencing_reads/PRJEB44507.tsv > sequencing_reads/PRJEB44507_2604only.tsv

## To Download
for i in $(awk -F '\t' '{ print $19 }' sequencing_reads/PRJEB44507_2604only.tsv); do
  curl $(echo $i | cut -d ';' -f 1) --remote-name --create-dirs --output-dir sequencing_reads
  curl $(echo $i | cut -d ';' -f 2) --remote-name --create-dirs --output-dir sequencing_reads
done
```

Once downloaded, we can write create the samplesheet, which looks like this:

```{csv}
sample,run_accession,instrument_platform,fastq_1,fastq_2,fasta
2604_sma,ERR5766165,ILLUMINA,/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/sequencing_reads/ERR5766165_1.fastq.gz,/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/sequencing_reads/ERR5766165_2.fastq.gz,
2604_lar,ERR5766167,ILLUMINA,/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/sequencing_reads/ERR5766166_1.fastq.gz,/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/sequencing_reads/ERR5766166_2.fastq.gz,
2604_med,ERR5766166,ILLUMINA,/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/sequencing_reads/ERR5766167_1.fastq.gz,/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/sequencing_reads/ERR5766167_2.fastq.gz,
```

Where each sample name corresponds to

- `_sma` shallow sequencing depth library at 20 million reads
- `_med` middle-sequencing depth at 100 million
- `_large` deep sequencing depth at 200 million reads

## Execution

We can then run nf-core/taxprofiler on this dataset of 3 differently depth-sequenced samples with the databases we generated previously.  

For example, for the full dataset of just under ~30,000 genomes:

```{bash}
###################### TODO UPDATE WHEN CRAZY_CORGI RELEASED #############
nextflow run nf-core/taxprofiler \
 -r dev \
 --input /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/taxprofiler_samplesheet.csv \
 --databases /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/createtaxdb/results_30000/downstream_samplesheets/databases-taxprofiler.csv
 -profile mpcdf,raven \
 -name txp_benchmark_30000 \
 --outdir /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/results_30000/ \
 --perform_shortread_qc \
 --perform_shortread_complexityfilter \
 --perform_shortread_redundancyestimation \
 --perform_shortread_hostremoval \
 --shortrad_hostremoval_reference /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/reference/human-t2t-hla.fa.gz \
 --hostremoval_index /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/reference/ \
 --run_centrifuge \
 --run_diamond \
 --run_kaiju \
 --run_kraken2 \
 --run_krakenuniq \
 --run_bracken \
 --run_metaphlan \
 --run_motus \
 --run_kmcp \
 --run_ganon \
 --run_profile_standardisation \
 --run_krona \
 --taxpasta_taxonomy_dir
 --/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary-files/ \
 

```
